description: What worldwide eSIM is and how it works, in the shop’s own words: one mobile-data eSIM for the whole world or chosen continents, one data pool, validity (until the data is used up, up to 90 days from the first connection), recharge, delivery, installation, devices, payment, refunds, My eSIM, e-mails, support. Use for any question that is not a price or a country.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country and continent names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.
